jobs.title: Overnight Armed Security Professional
jobs.description:
Own the Night. Protect What Matters.

Performance One Security is expanding its overnight operations across Dallas — and we're looking for sharp, composed professionals who thrive when the stakes are high and the lights go low. If you bring authority, awareness, and accountability to every shift, we want you on our team.

Who We Are

Performance One Security is a Level III Armed Security firm serving the DFW Metroplex with a reputation built on professionalism, integrity, and results. We partner with businesses, venues, and institutions that demand nothing less than excellence — and we deliver it through people, not just policies.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Establish a commanding, professional presence throughout the property during overnight hours
  • Oversee access control at entry points, verifying credentials and enforcing site-specific admission requirements
  • Monitor activity across the property, identifying and neutralizing potential threats before they develop
  • Manage pedestrian flow and occupancy levels to maintain a safe, controlled environment
  • Conduct scheduled and unscheduled interior and exterior patrols throughout the shift
  • Respond decisively to disturbances and remove non-compliant individuals when required
  • Partner with on-site management to enforce property policies with consistency and professionalism
  • Serve as the primary liaison with local law enforcement during critical incidents
  • Prepare thorough, accurate incident reports documenting security events and any use-of-force
What You Bring
  • Valid Texas Level III Armed Security License (required — no exceptions)
  • Prior armed security or law enforcement experience strongly preferred
  • Proven ability to remain calm, professional, and effective under pressure
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Self-directed work ethic with the ability to operate independently and within a team
  • Keen situational awareness and quick decision-making ability
  • Must clear background check and drug screening
Bonus Points For
  • Experience in nightlife, hospitality, or entertainment venue security
  • Prior crowd management or access control background
  • Familiarity with Texas public safety regulations
  • Advanced de-escalation and conflict resolution skills
  • Current First Aid / CPR certification
How to Apply Click Apply Now to submit your resume. A brief summary of your relevant experience is welcome but not required.

Performance One Security is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive team where all employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business need.

Pay: $18.00 - $21.00 per hour

Benefits

  • Dental insurance
  • Health insurance
  • Vision insurance
Application Question(s):
  • Are you able to work the weekends?
Experience:
  • Security: 1 year (Required)
Shift availability:
  • Overnight Shift (Preferred)
  • Night Shift (Preferred)
Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
About First Responder Protective Services


First Responder Protective Services is a premier provider of private security needs across the U.S. Our company is owned, operated and managed by U.S. Military veterans, law enforcement executives, and corporate business professionals. Our founders have over 60 years of experience in protecting critical infrastructures, combating transnational criminal organizations, mitigating risks, and providing the highest level of safety and security to corporations and communities.


The mission of First Responder Protective Services is to provide the highest level of customer service to each and every client. We accomplish this mission through our foundation of attention to detail, integrity, accountability, empathy, care, and concern for the needs of our clients and the officers which we serve.


Job Title: Non-Commissioned Security Guard (Level II)
Location: Grapevine
Pay: $18-$20 per hour, depending on qualifications (paid weekly)
Status: Full-time & Part-time

Position Summary


First Responder Protective Services (FRPS) is hiring multiple FLEX Non-Commissioned Security Guards to provide a consistent security presence at a controlled-access community in the Grapevine area. This position is primarily based in a spacious, climate-controlled guard shack, where officers will manage access control, monitor video surveillance and access systems, and check residents and visitors in and out of the property. The guard shack is equipped with basic necessities and access to clean, private restroom facilities. Officers will also conduct occasional patrols of the property, both on foot and by golf cart, to maintain visibility and ensure the safety of residents and property. Weekday and weekend shifts are available, with 24/7 coverage required.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage check-in/out residents and visitors in a climate controlled shack.
  • Monitor entrances, access points, and surveillance systems.
  • Respond promptly to alarms, emergencies, or incidents.
  • Prepare detailed incident and activity reports as required.
  • Remain alert and proactive in identifying and reporting security concerns
  • Follow all post orders and supervisor instructions
  • Occasional mobile and foot patrol in assigned areas to ensure safety and security of residents, staff, and property.


Requirements

  • Must have at least one year of experience unarmed security.
  • Must hold a current Level II Texas Noncommissioned Security License
  • Must have a valid Texas Driver’s License (or ability to obtain before starting)
  • Professional appearance and demeanor
  • Ability to work independently or with a team
  • Able to sit, stand, or walk for extended periods

  • Monday: 10p-6a

  • Wednesday: 10p-6a
  • Thursday: 10p-6a

Compensation & Advancement

  • Hourly Pay: $18-$20/hour (based on experience and availability)
  • Pay Frequency: Bi-weekly via direct deposit
  • Status: W2 employee (eligible for overtime after 40 hours in a workweek)

Full-Time Employee Benefits
